integrity: The full Pearson article was inspected at the model equations, homogeneous-kinetics discussion, phase diagram, saddle-node line, Hopf line, and periodic-orbit statements. A complete public author text of the 2017 homogeneous Gray–Scott bifurcation study was inspected through the exact ODE, equilibrium discriminant, stability sections, Takens–Bogdanov and Bautin results, and global bifurcation map; targeted full-text searches found no conditional, average, moment, or variance formulation. The 2021 repository record and abstract were checked for the complete phase-portrait classification; the listed postprint could not be retrieved through the checked route and is retained as a residual risk. The dual conditional laws, covariance calibrations, activity decompositions, and essential-supremum support argument were independently reconstructed and replayed with the packaged exact checker.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to compact invariant probability measures supported strictly inside the positive quadrant.
It concerns the spatially homogeneous kinetics rather than spatially varying reaction-diffusion invariant measures.
The saddle-node discriminant and positive equilibrium branches are classical prior Gray–Scott bifurcation structure.
The complete 2021 phase-portrait postprint was listed as open but was not retrievable in the checked route; equivalent support inequalities remain a literature risk.
Equivalent short weighted generator identities could remain in older unindexed chemical-kinetics literature.
title: Dual stationary nullcline calibration and activity defects in the Gray–Scott kinetics
